quotes: Das Abonnement läuft zunächst zwölf Monate und kann mit einer Frist von einem Monat zum Ende dieser Laufzeit gekündigt werden.

data.explanation: This letter confirms your new newspaper subscription (Abonnement) with Beispiellahn Zeitungsverlag, starting 1 December 2026, including the digital e-paper. It runs for a minimum of 12 months; after that it continues until you cancel it with one month's notice. No action is needed right now, but keep this letter for the terms. The monthly price of €42.50 will be charged regularly — check that it's debited correctly. If you ever want to end the subscription, note the one-month notice period described above.
